<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/services/topology"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns service-to-service dependency edges within the specified time
window. When `environment` is supplied, edges are restricted to those
originating from services tagged for that deployment environment;
target services (databases, caches, external endpoints) are not
required to carry an environment tag.
